items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html: The vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and downward, which descended below the conclusion of the second restriction, as above in answer 125, are also called external vessels, and they have two aspects: one, the externality from the side of the front, which are the two lower thirds of the Tifferet; and two, the externality from the side of the back, which are the NHYM. And both descended to the empty void at the time of the second restriction. (Item 3).
